# Personal Copilot instructions — goal alignment (applies to every repo)

- Before writing any code or content for a new task, check for `GOAL.md` at the repo root. If it is missing, run the goal-alignment-review skill in Capture mode and write it from my request before proceeding.
- Before adding any new file, output artifact, dependency, abstraction, safeguard, section, or slide, apply the goal-alignment-review gate: name the GOAL.md success criterion it serves. If none, stop and ask me.
- When I say "simpler", "shorter", "that's not what I asked", or correct the direction, re-read GOAL.md before the next change and propose an Amendment if the goal actually changed.
- Before opening a PR, finishing a document, or declaring a task done, run a goal-alignment-review checkpoint and show me the verdict and the Delete list.
- Never edit GOAL.md to match what was built.
